## Task Description / 任务描述

Some documents in the `introduction/` directory currently only have a Chinese version, and an English version needs to be added.
`introduction/` 目录下的部分文档目前只有中文版，需要补充英文版本。

### Documents to Translate / 需要翻译的文档

- `introduction/systems.md` - Core System Overview / 核心系统详解
- `introduction/extensions.md` - Extension System Overview / 扩展系统详解
- `introduction/deployment.md` - Deployment and Development Guide / 部署与开发指南

### Format Requirements / 格式要求

- Keep the original Markdown formatting and Mermaid diagrams intact / 保留原有的 Markdown 格式和 Mermaid 图表
- Bilingual format (Chinese + English, refer to the format in `README.md`) / 中英双语对照（参考 `README.md` 的格式）
- Or create a pure English version (e.g. `introduction/systems.en.md`) / 或者创建纯英文版本（如 `introduction/systems.en.md`）

### Acceptance Criteria / 验收标准

- [ ] Accurate translation with correct technical terminology / 翻译准确，技术术语正确
- [ ] Complete Markdown formatting with properly rendered diagrams / Markdown 格式完整，图表正常渲染
- [ ] Code blocks and command-line examples remain unchanged / 代码块、命令行示例保持原样

### Difficulty / 难度

⭐ Easy (Suitable for first-time contributors with good English skills) / 简单（适合英语能力好的首次贡献者）
